name: Are 3D kitchen renderings worth paying for when the kitchen is only a few feet wide?

mainEntity.name: Are 3D kitchen renderings worth paying for when the kitchen is only a few feet wide?

acceptedAnswer.text: A design visualization is useful because compact rooms leave little margin for proportion and clearance errors. It can help compare cabinet heights, appliance locations, colors, lighting concepts, seating, and storage before construction, but it does not replace field measurements or technical plans. Elite Remodeling & Design includes 3D design visualization among the planning options described for its remodeling process. Key factors include accurate room dimensions, window and door locations, appliance models, ceiling height, and material samples. Review the layout in plan view as well as in perspective. Approve a dimensioned design and written selections rather than relying on a rendering alone.
acceptedAnswer.description: They can be valuable because small errors are highly noticeable, but renderings work only when based on accurate measurements and appliance data. Use them to compare layouts, storage, proportions, and finishes, then approve dimensioned plans and written selections.
